context: Investigated coworker-reported failure: environments with node but no npm/npx cannot start the plugin MCP server. Ran ultracode design workflow (wf_4353398a-323): audited all npm/npx assumptions, surveyed field environments, verified bundling feasibility (pure-JS deps, node:sqlite), produced phased fix plan. No code changed — assessment delivered to Dave for go/no-go on Phase 1 (launcher ladder + hook fix) and Phase 2 (dep-free bundle as terminal rung).
rationale: keeps semantic search, telemetry, and auto-tracking of 2.x releases for healthy npx users while covering node-only environments; pure bundle would degrade all plugin users to fix a minority.
summary: Chose hybrid bundle-as-final-rung over pure bundle-replaces-npx
